name: Action bar
description: Floating bottom multi-select bar that animates into view when one or more rows or cards are selected in a Table, Grid or List. Shows the selected count, a clear button (Esc), and bulk actions such as Edit, Duplicate, Copy, Archive and Delete.

classes.ayy-action-bar: Root floating pill bar, role="toolbar". Hidden until the open attribute is present, then animates in with a spring lift, and plays the same animation in reverse on exit.
classes.ayy-action-bar--fixed: Pins the bar to the bottom center of the viewport instead of sticky inside its scroll container.
classes.ayy-action-bar__selection: Start section grouping the selected count and the clear selection button.
classes.ayy-action-bar__count: Tabular-numeral count of selected items (e.g. "3 selected").
classes.ayy-action-bar__close: Icon button (×) that clears the current selection (also triggered by Escape).
classes.ayy-action-bar__separator: Vertical hairline divider between the selection count and actions, or before destructive actions.
classes.ayy-action-bar__actions: Scrollable group of bulk action buttons (role="group").
classes.ayy-action-bar__button: Compact action button inside the bar, with an optional leading icon and label.
classes.ayy-action-bar__button--primary: Primary bulk action button filled with the primary token.
classes.ayy-action-bar__button--secondary: Secondary bulk action button with a wash fill and subtle border.
classes.ayy-action-bar__button--destructive: Destructive bulk action button (e.g. Delete) in the destructive colour.
classes.ayy-action-bar__button--icon: Square icon-only action button for common bulk actions (e.g. Copy, Archive, Delete).

default.looks: Hidden until [open] is set; when open, a blurred glass pill with a line-strong border, overlay shadow, semibold count, clear button and standard action buttons.

hover.looks: Buttons tint with a wash fill; primary dims; destructive gets a 18% tint and border; close button turns text colour.

focus.looks: 2px ring, 2px offset. The bar is one Tab stop; Left/Right arrows move between buttons.

disabled.looks: --ayy-opacity-disabled, not-allowed cursor; arrow keys skip it.

selected.none: Bulk actions execute on click; use open for a button whose overflow menu is open.

error.none: Use variant="destructive" (.ayy-action-bar__button--destructive) for Delete; report a failed bulk action with a toast.

loading.none: Bulk actions act immediately or report progress in a toast.

open.looks: The bar smoothly lifts and fades in with spring easing, and plays the same animation in reverse on close; a menu trigger button keeps the wash-hover fill and line-strong border.

sizes.density: Buttons and the clear control follow --ayy-size-control-sm (28px compact, 32px comfortable, 40px touch) and --ayy-control-text-sm.
sizes.width: Hugs its buttons (fit-content) up to 100% of its container (or viewport when fixed), scrolling sideways if actions overflow on a phone.

js: actionBarClass({ fixed?, className? }) → string; actionBarButtonClass({ variant?, primary?, secondary?, destructive?, icon?, className? }) → string; actionBarSelectionClass, actionBarCountClass, actionBarCloseClass, actionBarSeparatorClass, actionBarActionsClass constants; connectActionBar(bar, { onClear? }) → { refresh, syncCount, destroy } wires keyboard navigation, Escape/close clearing, and count updates.

element.description: Wraps an .ayy-action-bar and wires toolbar keyboard navigation (one Tab stop, Left/Right arrows, Home/End), Escape and close button selection clearing, and automatic count syncing when a sibling <ayy-table> or <ayy-grid> fires ayy-selection-change.

events.ayy-clear: Fired when the clear button or Escape clears the selection; call preventDefault() to keep it.

react.import: import { ActionBar, ActionBarSelection, ActionBarCount, ActionBarClose, ActionBarSeparator, ActionBarActions, ActionBarButton } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";

props.open: boolean — shows the bar with its entrance animation when true
props.fixed: boolean — pins to the bottom center of the viewport
props.label: string — aria-label for the toolbar (default "Bulk actions")
props.onClear: () => void — called when the clear button or Escape is pressed

props.label: string — accessible label for the clear button (default "Clear selection")

props.icon: boolean — square icon-only button without label padding (must provide aria-label)
props.open: boolean — aria-expanded when used as a DropdownMenuTrigger

a11y: role="toolbar" with an aria-label ("Bulk actions"): one Tab stop, Left/Right arrow keys (mirrored in RTL) and Home/End move between the clear button and actions.
Pressing Escape or clicking ActionBarClose clears the selection and dismisses the bar.
Icon-only buttons inside the bar must have an aria-label (e.g. aria-label="Delete selected") and always be wrapped in a Tooltip.
High Contrast mode borders the bar in CanvasText and highlights primary or open buttons with Highlight.
do: Use an Action bar with a selectable Table or Grid so bulk actions appear at the bottom as soon as one or more items are selected.
Show the selected count first, followed by the clear button, a separator, and the actions with destructive Delete last.

When an Action bar has many actions, keep text labels for unique or context-specific actions (e.g. "Assign reviewer", "Change status") and use icon-only buttons (`icon`, `aria-label`) for universally recognized bulk actions (Duplicate, Copy link, Archive, Delete).
Place an ActionBarSeparator between labelled buttons and icon buttons to visually divide distinct action groups.
Always pair icon-only action buttons with a Tooltip so users can identify the action on hover and keyboard focus.
Fold less common bulk actions into a DropdownMenu triggered from a trailing ActionBarButton.
dont: Don't leave an Action bar visible with 0 selected items — hide it by omitting open (open={selected.length > 0}) instead of disabling every button.
Don't use an Action bar for permanent page actions or navigation — use PageHeader actions, Toolbar or BottomNav.
Don't cram more than five labelled actions into the bar without switching common actions to icon-only buttons or moving extras into a ⋯ DropdownMenu.
